senses.gloss: --the wife of बाणासुर. Illtreated by mother-in-law and sister-in-law she was initiated into a मन्त्र by नारद to control them and to be ever pleasing to her husband. By this she left the strict path of chastity; offered gifts to the sage who refused them on the plea of his plenty. M. १८७. २५-52. [page१-063+ २७]
